name: picovoice-wake-word-benchmark
description:
Picovoice Wake Word Benchmark Dataset
	

This dataset contains a collection of wake word recordings used for benchmarking wake word detection systems. The dataset has been reformatted from the original Picovoice Wake Word Benchmark repository for easier use with Hugging Face's ecosystem.

	
		
		Dataset Description

general_score_metric: F1 score (and false accept / false reject rates)
reputation: Used in wake-word research and by practitioners working with Picovoice tooling; a common small-scale benchmark for wake-word systems.
